v.en: O God, come to my assistance;

r.en: O Lord, make haste to help me.

source.scope: Psalmi & antiphonæ ex Psalterio secundum diem

text.la: Benígne fac, Dómine, * in bona voluntáte tua Sion.
text.en: In thy good will, O Lord, * deal favourably with Sion.

text.la: Rectus Dóminus, * Deus noster, et non est iníquitas in eo.
text.en: The Lord our God is righteous * and there is no iniquity in him.

text.la: A timóre inimíci * éripe, Dómine, ánimam meam.
text.en: Deliver my soul, * O Lord, from the fear of the enemy.

text.la: In servis suis * miserébitur Dóminus et propítius erit terræ pópuli sui.
text.en: The Lord will judge * his servants, and will have mercy on the people of his land.

text.la: Laudáte * Dóminum secúndum multitúdinem magnitúdinis eius.
text.en: Praise ye the Lord * according to the excellence of his greatness.

text.la: Nox præcéssit, dies autem appropinquávit. Abiciámus ergo ópera tenebrárum, et induámur arma lucis. Sicut in die honéste ambulémus.
text.en: The night is passed, and the day is at hand. Let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and put on the armour of light. Let us walk honestly, as in the day.

v.en: We are filled in the morning with thy mercy.

r.en: And we have rejoiced, and are delighted.

text.la: Illúmina, Dómine, * sedéntes in ténebris et umbra mortis, et dírige pedes nostros in viam pacis.
text.en: Give light, O Lord, to them that sit in darkness, * and guide our feet into the way of peace, O Thou the God of Israel.

text.la: Omnípotens sempitérne Deus, qui per continéntiam salutárem corpóribus medéris et méntibus: maiestátem tuam súpplices exorámus; ut pia ieiunántium deprecatióne placátus, et præséntia nobis subsídia tríbuas, et futúra.
text.en: O God, Who hast chosen healthy fasting, as a mean to do good both to bodies and to souls, we humbly implore thy Majesty, that the godly prayer of such as be fasting this day may turn away thy wrath, and may be effectual to gain for us thy blessing in time and in eternity.
